future_f1_purpose_and_claims.technical_purpose: Run one separately authorized, controlled, single-fault packet-loss attempt on the exact bound context to determine whether the fixed mutation is physically effective, whether the exact conditional signature supports the scoped packet-loss diagnosis, and whether the owned network and measurement environment restore cleanly.

fault_effectiveness.meaning: Independent empirical check that the exact NetEm/pfifo hierarchy was active, 6-25 of 150 ping probes were lost, child pfifo overflow delta was zero, and mutation command acceptance was not used as proof of effect.

diagnosis.meaning: R_X6_PERFORMANCE_001 may diagnose packet_loss at r2:eth2 only when all six bound predicates are observed and true after independent reconstruction.

restoration.meaning: Owned NetEm/pfifo removal, exact noqueue/no-filter restoration, no lingering traffic, standalone replay, three restoration windows within the accepted frozen inclusive bounds, and zero owned residual resources.

scientific_acceptance.future_condition: Only a complete separately authorized attempt that passes the successor independent materialized verifier may support authoritative acceptance for the exact single-F1 bound context.
scientific_acceptance.claim_limit: No generalization, dataset, model, metric, API, thesis, multi-host, multi-image, multi-topology, or multi-fault claim follows.

utilization_elapsed_time.qualified_baseline: Elapsed time is independently reconstructed from the first pre-control command started.monotonic_ns through the last post-control command completed.monotonic_ns.

utilization_elapsed_time.impact: The historical baseline/fault/restored utilization values are not directly comparable with the accepted manifest and the historical verifier checks only that elapsed_seconds is positive.

threshold_flow.historical: The runner builds a new X6_TRAFFIC_01_FROZEN_TCP_AND_PING manifest from its ten runtime baseline windows, and the historical verifier requires those windows as threshold inputs.
threshold_flow.required_successor: Load and validate the exact accepted X6_R1_BASELINE_ONLY_QUALIFICATION manifest from the published freeze record; copy it canonically into run evidence and bind the source record, source commit, embedded digest, complete-file digest, and run-local digest before mutation.

comparison_semantics.pre_fault_and_restoration: Normalize numeric observations to six places with ROUND_HALF_EVEN and require every value within both frozen inclusive bounds; require directly established rate_limit_detected=false.
comparison_semantics.fault_diagnosis: Preserve the existing feature-specific directional R_X6_PERFORMANCE_001 predicates against the same immutable manifest.
comparison_semantics.historical_gap: _within_restored_baseline uses directional checks and does not enforce the accepted lower utilization boundary.

compatibility_analysis.lifecycle_gap: The historical runner/verifier predates the accepted one-attempt reservation, raw command identity/timestamp, durable terminalization, cleanup reconstruction, and cross-boot recovery semantics. A future production path cannot be justified by calling the historical runner directly.

proposed_minimum_source_correction.production: Add a versioned F1 successor production CLI that uses the accepted R1.4.1 durable authorization, command recording, teardown classification, ownership-scoped cleanup, terminalization, and recovery patterns with an F1-specific immutable contract and phase state machine.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.measurement: Add a phase-aware successor observation path that records shell-false bounded raw commands and reconstructs baseline, fault, and restored utilization from first pre-control start through last post-control completion. Keep healthy STRUCTURAL_ZERO_NO_MANAGED_QUEUE distinct from fault COUNTER_DELTA_CHILD_PFIFO_20.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.thresholds: Add a fail-closed manifest loader that extracts the exact accepted frozen manifest, verifies canonical bytes and all bound hashes, writes an identical run-local copy before mutation, and has no production path to build_threshold_manifest.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.baseline_admission: Treat all ten future pre-fault baseline windows as validation-only against the exact inclusive frozen bounds and direct rate-limit evidence. Any failure terminalizes the spent attempt before mutation; it cannot retune or select windows.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.fault_and_rule: Preserve the three fault windows, pooled RTT rule, 6-25 effectiveness bound, exact phase controls, Evidence v4, Feature Vector v2, and R_X6_PERFORMANCE_001, all independently reconstructed from bound raw observations.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.restoration: Require owned mutation reversal, exact noqueue/no-filter controls, cooldown, no lingering traffic, standalone recovery/replay, three restoration windows within inclusive frozen bounds, and final owned-resource absence with host-drift checks.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.verification: Add a versioned source gate and independent materialized verifier for the successor. Neither may treat historical X6_R1 source tests, the baseline qualification, or synthetic fixtures as runtime proof.
proposed_minimum_source_correction.why_minimum: Changing the shared historical collector would alter published baseline and F1 behavior. An append-only phase-aware successor reuses accepted parsing and feature formulas while isolating the necessary timing, lifecycle, authorization, and manifest-consumption corrections.
